protocol: USAF physiology training, generally including a 43,000-ft chamber flight. Grade IV denotes hospitalization under the source classification.
outcome_window: Chamber-associated severe reactors reported during 1956. Uniform postexposure follow-up unavailable.
locator: Berry 1958, Disposition, p. 946. Corroborated by Berry 1957, printed p. 10 (PDF p. 11).
note: The same report gives 110 per 100,000 trainees on p. 940. The exact 1956 training denominator is unavailable. The 51,580 denominator printed in Table 2 is for 1955. This Grade IV hospitalization classification includes historical dysbarism reactions, with no modern diagnostic adjudication.
